---
name: explain-back
description: Use when Maria asks to explain code, or before moving on from a step. Explain every file in plain English so she can explain it back.
---

When you use this skill:

1. For each file changed in this step, say in plain English:
   - What it does
   - What happens if it is removed
   - What it connects to
2. Keep it to 2-3 sentences per file. No jargon without explaining it.
3. Ask Maria: "Can you explain this back to me in your own words?"
4. If she cannot, rewrite that part more simply first. Do not move on to the next step.
5. Add a short comment at the top of any file that is still hard to follow.
